items: P-waves travel through solid, liquid, and gas, whereas S-waves propagate ONLY through solids.
The shadow zone for S-waves is significantly larger than that of P-waves, spanning the entire zone beyond 103° from the epicenter.
Surface waves (L-waves) are the last to record on a seismograph and cause the most destructive ground displacement.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Body waves originate at the focus and travel through the Earth's interior, categorized into Primary (P) and Secondary (S) waves.
Primary waves (P-waves) are longitudinal compressional waves that travel through solids, liquids, and gases.
Secondary waves (S-waves) are transverse shear waves that travel exclusively through solid medium.
Surface waves (L-waves) travel along the Earth's surface, move with the slowest velocity, and cause maximum physical damage.
The existence and geometry of shadow zones provide direct evidence regarding the physical state of the Earth's core.
